title: 第四十八章丛林迷宫第四十七章荡尽天下魔修
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 张守安等人一落地，四周的场景瞬间变为了一幅巨大的森林场景。
树木粗壮无比，简直直插天际，高耸的树冠瞬间将太阳洒下的阳光完全挡住，导致此刻张守安等人存在的空间都有些昏沉。
众人身形刚刚站定，胖子却一脚踹开汉子，完全不顾汉子的感受，然后蹲在一旁，开始擦拭自己的鞋子。
汉子一个踉跄，往前方掠出几步，险些就要撞在前方的巨石上。
这可不是简单打打骂骂那么简单了，这要是撞上，脑袋上必然会见红。
汉子想要停下，却是根本停止不了，眼看着巨石离自己越来越近，他只能闭上了眼睛。
可是，张守安却是从他身后，一把拽住他的衣服。
他的整个身形，才终于稳了下来，此刻都有些劫后余生的感觉。
而后大口大口地喘了口气，看了眼身后的张守安，眼里既有惊恐，还有感激。
张守安慢慢松手，然后看向不远的胖子。
反正自己肯定要离开这个队伍，为什么不揍他一顿。
要说原因……
可能就是看他不顺眼吧。
他一拳握紧，刚要有所动作的时候，所有人的腰间却是凭空出现一个腰包。
这时一道传音入耳之声，响彻在众人耳旁。
“前往中央区域，击败他人，夺取每人腰包中的金币。”
“每人目前有5枚基本金币，最后在中区域，金币最多者，可借此兑换奖励。”
话音逐渐消散，但任务的要求也都印在了众人心里。
胖子还在擦着鞋，只是嘴角不耐烦地说道：“知道该做什么了吧，把金币都交给我。”
他没看众人，就好像说一件什么理所应当的事情。
张守安回看了眼众人，却发现大家却是自觉开始掏腰包中的金币。
张守安则是耐心等了等。
终于，胖子擦干了鞋子，看向众人。
他几步走了过来，一把夺过第一个人手中的金币，然后是下一个。
最后，终于来到了张守安面前，他看着两手空空地张守安，面色不悦道：“你的呢？等着我亲自去你腰包里拿？”
“你要脸吗！”
他抬手一个巴掌就要扇向张守安脸庞，不过此刻倒是不觉得张守安脸庞脏了。
张守安倒是一时没有回击，只是静静等着。
就在距离只有一点点时，他一掌从下向上推出，直直打在胖子下巴上。
而后是“啪”的一声，胖子完全就没反应过来，就这么仰头倒飞出一点距离。
他的脖子完全闪了一下，摔在地上后，疼得完全都回不过来。
他挣扎着地大喊道：“你！你敢打我！你找死！”
可张守安却是几步来到他身边，然后蹲下，透过中年易容的脸庞一笑。
而后一手捏住脖颈，稍稍发力。
“我找不找死不知道，但现在，你好像要死了。”冷淡至极的声音从张守安嘴里发出，就像是在审判着什么。
“你……”一股窒息感涌了上来，胖子完全顾不上疼痛，脚步胡乱扑腾着。
周遭的几人吓得不轻，此刻皆是不敢动。
又是那个汉子走了出来，他一手按在张守安肩膀，劝导：“兄弟，你这样咱们都得死。”
张守安却是没看他，只是继续说道：“你以为咱们进了这里，还能活下来吗？”
汉子一阵无言，手只是继续搭在张守安肩膀上。
content_en:
As soon as Zhang Shou'an and others landed, the surrounding scene instantly turned into a huge forest scene.
The trees were so thick that they almost reached the sky. The towering canopy instantly completely blocked the sunlight shining down from the sun, causing the space where Zhang Shouan and others existed to feel a little groggy at this moment.
As soon as everyone stood still, the fat man kicked the man away, completely ignoring the man's feelings, then squatted aside and began to wipe his shoes.
The man staggered and took a few steps forward, almost hitting the boulder ahead.
This is not as simple as beating and scolding. If you hit him like this, your head will definitely turn red.
The man wanted to stop, but he couldn't. Seeing the boulder getting closer and closer to him, he could only close his eyes.
However, Zhang Shouan grabbed his clothes from behind.
His entire figure finally stabilized, and he felt like he was surviving a disaster.
Then he took a deep breath and glanced at Zhang Shou'an behind him, with fear and gratitude in his eyes.
Zhang Shou'an slowly let go, and then looked at the fat man not far away.
He was definitely going to leave the team anyway, so why not beat him up.
To tell the reason...
Maybe he just doesn't like it.
He clenched his fist, and just when he was about to make a move, a pocket bag appeared out of thin air on everyone's waist.
At this time, a voice came into the ears, resounding in everyone's ears.
"Go to the central area, defeat others, and seize the gold coins in everyone's pockets."
"Each person currently has 5 basic gold coins. Finally, in the middle area, the person with the most gold coins can exchange them for rewards."
The words gradually faded away, but the requirements of the mission were also imprinted in everyone's hearts.
The fat man was still polishing his shoes, but he said impatiently: "You know what to do now, give me all the gold coins."
He didn't look at the crowd, as if he was saying something that should be taken for granted.
Zhang Shou'an looked back at everyone, only to find that everyone consciously started to take out the gold coins in their pockets.
Zhang Shou'an waited patiently.
Finally, the fat man wiped his shoes and looked at everyone.
He walked over in a few steps, snatched the gold coin from the first person's hand, and then the next one.
Finally, he came to Zhang Shou'an. He looked at Zhang Shou'an with empty hands and said with an unhappy expression, "Where's yours? Are you waiting for me to take it from your pocket in person?"
"Do you want face!"
He raised his hand and was about to slap Zhang Shou'an in the face, but at this moment he didn't feel that Zhang Shou'an's face was dirty.
Zhang Shou'an did not fight back for a while, but just waited quietly.
Just when the distance was just a little bit away, he pushed his palm from bottom to top and hit the fat man's chin directly.
Then there was a "pop" sound, and the fat man didn't react at all, and just raised his head and flew a little distance.
His neck completely flashed, and after he fell to the ground, he was in so much pain that he couldn't recover at all.
He struggled and shouted: "You! You dare to hit me! You are looking for death!"
But Zhang Shouan came to him in a few steps, then squatted down and smiled through the middle-aged disguised face.
Then he pinched his neck with one hand and exerted a little force.
"I don't know if I'm looking for death, but now, it seems that you are going to die." An extremely cold voice came from Zhang Shou'an's mouth, as if he was judging something.
"You..." A feeling of suffocation came over him, and the fat man ignored the pain and flapping around randomly.
Several people around him were so frightened that they did not dare to move at this moment.
The man came out again. He put his hand on Zhang Shou'an's shoulder and persuaded: "Brother, if you do this, we will all die."
Zhang Shou'an did not look at him, but continued: "Do you think we can survive if we enter here?"
The man was speechless for a while, but continued to put his hand on Zhang Shou'an's shoulder.
